WORK EXPERIENCE Should have satisfactorily completed the similar work(s) as mentioned below during the last 7 years ending previous day of last date of submission of bids i. Three similar works each costing not (or) ii. Two similar works each costing not less than Rs. 367.20 Lakhs (or) iii. One similar work costing not less than Rs. 489.60 Lakhs Documentary proof: (i) Work order(s) / Purchase Order(s) and Completion certificates issued by the competent authority concerned to establish work experience. (ii) Completion certificates for works issued by Private parties shall be supported by TDS (Tax Deducted at sources) certificates.

b i. Similar work shall mean: “Construction of BT roads” (or) “Any major civil works with road works component of value not less than 60% of amount put to tender” ii. The value of executed work shall be brought to current costing level by enhancing the actual value of work at a simple rate of 7% per annum, calculated from the date of completion to last date of submission of bid (including fraction of years). iii. Work executed as subcontract / Joint Venture / consortium will not merit for evaluation. II. FINANCIAL SOUNDNESS

a Should have had average annual financial turnover not less than Rs.183.60 lakhs during the last three years ending 31st March of preceding year (31/03/2025). Documentary proof: Chartered Accountant certificate for the Annual financial turnover and balance sheet showing Profit & Loss.
b Should not have incurred any loss in more than two years during the last five years ending 31st March 2025.

c Should have a solvency of not less than Rs. 244.80 Lakhs. Documentary proof: Latest Solvency Certificate issued by any Scheduled Bank not older than 06 months from date of submission of bids. III. BIDDING CAPACITY The bidding capacity of the contractor should be more than the amount put to tender. The bidding capacity shall be worked out and declared by the tenderer and enclosed with the request for tender document based on the formula: Documentary proof: (i) A statement showing the value of existing commitments and ongoing works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed to be furnished as per format 1 enclosed. (ii) Current costing level for value of work may be worked out as mentioned under the Note (ii) above. (AxNx1.5)-B A- Maximum turnover in construction works executed in any one year during the last 5 years taking into account the work completed as well as work in progress. The value of competed works shall be brought to current costing level. B - Value of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next ‘N’ years at current price level. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the subject contract for which bids are invited (N = period of completion in months/12) Important Note: Bidders may note that above criteria are only minimum qualifying criteria. For obtaining the required marks in qualifying criteria of stage 2 evaluation, bidders may refer criteria in section A-4 (evaluation part) and submit the required qualifying documents for Financial Strength and Experience in similar class etc.
